sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source on Sources for attribution limits.

strict.criterion: Human-machine creative collaborations move beyond isolated novelty demonstrations to earn broad cultural and artistic recognition.
strict.rationale: Christie's October 2018 sale of a GAN-generated portrait drew major publicity, but remained an isolated early auction event before 2019. Broad cultural engagement with human-AI art, music, and writing arrived only with the 2020s generative-AI wave.
changedConditions: Requires broad cultural recognition beyond a single 2018 novelty auction

evidence.title: Christie’s: Human-machine art collaboration at auction
evidence.note: Obvious/GAN portrait sold October 2018 for $432,500. Supports serious institutional attention, not majority adoption by artists.

reference.criterion: Human-machine artistic collaborations emerge and receive serious cultural/institutional attention.
reference.rationale: Christie’s 2018 sale of a GAN-assisted work created by a human collective establishes serious institutional attention before 2019. The modest emergence-and-recognition claim was fulfilled. It did not require most artists or leading artists to be machines.
